task: volume-aware sensitivity for the background-volume confound (PDF review r4)

test1_leave_one_volume_out_4class_ship.note: ResNet 4-class ship-type, train on ships from other volumes, test on held-out volume; compare to random-split 0.439. Stability indicates acoustic, not volume-tag, discrimination.

test2_cross_volume_background_detection.note: background VOLUME held out (train bg=E, test bg=H); AUC near the random-split 0.79 indicates the detector is acoustic, not keyed to a volume-specific signature.
